label: D1 near episode end (low value) after an a2 choice that rarely led to S1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (fixation) steps, and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode: 96% of activation mass falls in trials 90-99, none before trial 80. The model value output is low there (99.6% of mass at value < 5.22, the bottom value bin). Within that late-episode D1 window it is selective for the previous trial having been an a2 choice that made a rare transition to S1 (prev_action == 2 and prev_common == 0, about 87% of mass). Previous-trial reward modulates only weakly, with unrewarded slightly favored. It never fires at GO or D2, and almost never after an a1 choice or a common transition. The policy at these steps leans toward a2 (choice logit negative). Most missed activations are on the window first trial, where the previous trial falls outside the window (prev_action unknown), plus some weak firings after common a2 trials. Dev: P 0.70, R 0.75, F1 0.72, mass recall 0.87. All variables are observed (the previous trial history and the model own value output), so no future variables are used.
